comment.heading: Add a comment
comment.placeholder: Write a comment… Markdown is supported.

post.commentsOnHub: Post comments need a Hub web session — connect one in Settings → Account, or open the post on the Hub to reply.

hide.hiddenWithReason: This comment has been hidden (marked as {{reason}}).
hide.selectReason: Select a reason to hide this comment (optional):
hide.title: Hide comment
hide.warning: Hiding a comment cannot be undone. No one will be able to see its content anymore.

error.auth: The translation provider rejected this key. Check the API key in Translation Settings.
error.empty-response: The translation provider returned no text. Retry the request.
error.forbidden: This translation provider denied the request. Check your account permissions.
error.input-too-long: This post is too long to translate. Shorten it or split the content.
error.invalid-config: The translation settings are invalid. Check the model and endpoint, then try again.
error.malformed-response: The translation response could not be read. Retry, or try another provider.
error.model-not-found: The configured translation model was not found. Check the model ID.
error.not-configured: Translation is not configured. Add a provider in Translation Settings.
error.provider-unavailable: The translation provider is unavailable. Try again in a moment.
error.rate-limited: The translation provider is rate-limiting requests. Wait a moment, then retry.
error.refused: The translation provider refused this post. Try a different post or provider.
error.timeout: The translation request timed out. Check your network or proxy, then retry.
error.unknown: Translation failed. Retry, or check Translation Settings.

unwatchOpenHub: The Hub ignores Unwatch from apps — use Unwatch on their Hub page.
watchOpenHub: The Hub ignores Watch from apps — use Watch repositories on their Hub page.
watchSessionExpired: The Hub ignored this watch change — your Hub web session may have expired. Reconnect it in Settings → Account.
watchSuccess: Watching — you'll get Hub notifications for this account.
watchSyncNotApplied: Followed locally. The Hub ignores watch requests from apps — to also get Hub notifications for this account, use the Watch button on its Hub page.
